title: Settings
subtitle: Your company details, branding and defaults. Changes apply to new quotes, PDFs and emails.
storeUnavailable: Saved settings couldn't be loaded right now, so the values from .env and the built-in defaults are shown. Reload the page in a moment before making changes.

guard.title: Save your changes?
guard.description: You have unsaved changes in {section}. Save them before you leave, or discard them.

toast.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
toast.failed: Couldn't save your settings. Please try again.

source.envBody: This value comes from {name}. Saving a new value here overrides it; the .env file stays unchanged.

reset.title: Reset this field?
reset.toEnv: The saved value will be removed and {name} from .env will apply again:
reset.toDefault: The saved value will be removed and the built-in default will apply again:

company.title: Company
company.description: Who the quotes come from. Shown in the header of every quote, PDF and email.
company.detailsDescription: Leave a field empty to hide it on your quotes.
company.name: Company name
company.nameLocalHint: Shown under the main name, e.g. your Chinese company name.
company.nameLocalPlaceholder: e.g. 艾克米科技股份有限公司
company.vatNumberHint: In Taiwan, your 8-digit Unified Business Number.

preview.title: Preview
preview.caption: How your details appear at the top of quotes and PDFs.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Your logo, company seal, app icon and brand colour.
branding.imagesDescription: Drag an image onto a box or click it to choose a file. Changes are saved right away.
branding.colorDescription: Used for buttons, links and highlights in the app, and as the accent on quotes and PDFs.
branding.hexHint: Any colour, e.g. #1D4ED8. Very light colours are darkened in the app so text stays readable.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Top of every quote and PDF.
logo.hint: PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB. A wide PNG with a transparent background looks best.
logo.removeEffect: Quotes and PDFs will use the default logo (or the file in the branding folder) instead.

stamp.title: Company seal
stamp.description: Printed near the signature area of PDFs.
stamp.hint: A square PNG with a transparent background, at least 300 × 300 px.
stamp.removeEffect: PDFs will be printed without a seal.

icon.title: App icon
icon.description: Home screen, browser tab and the top bar.
icon.hint: A square PNG, at least 512 × 512 px. Without one, your logo is used.
icon.removeEffect: The app will use your logo as its icon. Installed apps may take a while to pick up the change.

branding.orClick: or click to choose a PNG or JPEG
branding.uploadFailed: Couldn't upload the image. Please try again.

warnings.notSquare: This image isn't square, so it will be fitted inside a square with empty space around it.
warnings.small: This image is quite small and may look blurry on high-resolution screens and in print.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: Numbering and the defaults every new quote starts with.
quotes.numberingDescription: New quotes are numbered automatically. Existing quotes keep their numbers.

patternErrors.TOO_LONG: The format can be at most 64 characters.
patternErrors.BAD_SEQ_PAD: The running number can have 1 to 9 digits, e.g. '{SEQ:3}'.

quotes.patternHint: Other characters are kept as typed. The running number starts again at 1 whenever the rest of the number changes, e.g. every day when the format includes '{DD}'.
quotes.defaultsDescription: Pre-filled on every new quote; you can still change them per quote.
quotes.defaultNotesHint: Shown on the quote, e.g. delivery or warranty details.
quotes.defaultTermsHint: Printed at the end of the quote.
quotes.defaultTermsPlaceholder: e.g. 1. This quote is valid for 30 days.
quotes.documentDescription: Extras printed on quotes and PDFs.
quotes.showAmountInWordsHint: Useful for formal quotes in Taiwan, e.g.
quotes.footerTextHint: A short line at the bottom of every page, e.g. a thank-you note.
quotes.footerTextPlaceholder: e.g. Thank you for your business!

payment.title: Payment
payment.description: Bank details printed on quotes so customers know where to pay.
payment.accountDescription: Leave everything empty to hide the payment section.
payment.previewEmpty: Nothing to show yet: the payment section is hidden on quotes.
payment.previewCaption: How the payment details appear on quotes and PDFs.

email.title: Email
email.description: How quotes are sent to customers by email.
email.statusOnBody: Quotes can be emailed from the quote page. The Resend API key is set in the server's .env file as RESEND_API_KEY.
email.statusOffBody: To email quotes, add RESEND_API_KEY to the server's .env file and restart the app. You can fill in the details below in the meantime.
email.senderDescription: What customers see in their inbox.
email.senderNameHint: Leave empty to use your company name.
email.senderEmailHint: Must use a domain you verified in Resend. Leave empty to use {fallback}.
email.replyToHint: Where customer replies go, e.g. your sales inbox.
email.ccEmailsHint: Up to {max} addresses that get a copy of every quote email.
email.ccPlaceholder: Type an email and press Enter
email.ccFull: You can add up to {max} addresses.

regional.title: Regional
regional.description: Currency, number formatting, time zone and local features.
regional.moneyDescription: Used for every amount in the app, on quotes and in PDFs.
regional.currencyLocaleHint: The number format decides symbols and separators, independent of the app's language.
regional.currencyWarning: Changing the currency doesn't convert existing amounts: quotes you already made will show the same numbers in the new currency.
regional.timeDescription: Decides what "today" is for quote dates, numbering and expiry.
regional.timezoneHint: Search by city or offset, e.g. Taipei or +8.
regional.vatLookupHint: Adds a lookup button next to the customer's VAT number in the quote form, which fills in the company name and address from the government's open data (GCIS).

about.title: About
about.description: Version, installation, security and your data.
about.precedence: Values saved on this page take precedence over the server's .env file, which in turn overrides the built-in defaults.
about.authOnBody: Everyone signs in with the shared password set as APP_PASSWORD in the server's .env file. Change it there to sign everyone out.
about.authOffBody: Set APP_PASSWORD in the server's .env file and restart the app to require a password.
about.authOffWarning: Anyone who can open this address can see and change your quotes.
about.installDescription: Open it from your home screen or dock like any other app, in its own window.
about.installIos: iPhone and iPad: in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
about.installOther: Android and computers: use Install in the browser menu or address bar (Chrome, Edge).
about.dataDescription: Everything is stored in your own database.
about.backupBody: For a full backup including settings and images, back up the PostgreSQL database, e.g. with pg_dump.
about.docsDescription: Guides for running the app yourself.

docs.httpsHint: Needed to install the app on phones
